en: Decorative vintage postcard with a colored illustration. On the left is an elaborate coat of arms featuring three blue lions on a yellow shield, topped with a crowned helmet, and above it a crowned woman in a red dress. Below the shield is a scroll bearing a greeting text. To the right is a framed panoramic view of a harbor city at sunset, with several church spires, waterfront buildings, ships and steam boats on the water, bordered by ornamental scrollwork.
